name: beatflow-backend
description: BeatFlow music backend — YouTube Music search + audio stream extraction (Express).

scripts.update-ytdlp: bash -c 'ARCH=$(uname -m); case $ARCH in x86_64|amd64) F=yt-dlp_linux;; aarch64|arm64) F=yt-dlp_linux_aarch64;; *) echo unsupported; exit 1;; esac; mkdir -p bin; curl -fL --retry 3 -o bin/yt-dlp https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/$F && chmod +x bin/yt-dlp && bin/yt-dlp --version'
